final_message:
I built the Ploverdesk landing page, but I couldn't build or open it. The sandbox blocks `node` and `npm`, so `npm run build` never ran. Nothing was validated by a person either: I made every design decision myself and marked it UNVALIDATED.

## The page

From top to bottom:

1. **Header**: the name Ploverdesk, a "Book a demo" link and a "Start the 14-day trial" button. The button is hidden below 30rem, since the same button sits just below it in the hero.
2. **First screen**: the headline "Your team reviews only the invoice lines that don't match.", a short description, the trial button, "No credit card needed." and the demo link. Under them, an example invoice from a packaging supplier, clearly labelled as illustrative. Its 7 lines are compared with the purchase order and the delivery note. 3 of them are flagged in red, one for each case in the brief: wrong quantity, wrong unit price, never delivered. A toggle, "What your team reviews (3)", hides the 4 matching lines.
3. **"From the inbox to the accounting system"**: four short points covering how invoices arrive, the matching, what a person sees, and payment approval plus CSV/API export.
4. **"One price per company"**: 290 EUR per month, no limit on users, 14-day trial with no credit card, hosted in Frankfurt, the trial button and demo link again, and one honest line: six people in Rotterdam, founded in 2025.
5. **Footer**: Rotterdam, and data hosted in Frankfurt.

There are no logos, testimonials or usage numbers. The only figures beyond the brief's are the quantities and prices in the example invoice, which is labelled as an example. The trial button has the same label everywhere, and every trial link goes to `/trial`, every demo link to `/demo`.

## Design

- **Look**: a cool near-white page with near-black text. Red (#B3261E) appears only on a value that doesn't match. The buttons are black, never red. Matching lines get a grey tick.
- **Type**: the system font with aligned figures. No web font, since none could load here and nobody agreed to one.
- **Layout**: one left edge for every section, flat, thin rules, 2px corners, no shadows.
- **Motion**: hover changes colour only, in 120ms. Nothing happens on scroll. The one animation is the toggle: matching lines leave in 160ms using the browser's built-in View Transitions. With reduced motion, or in a browser without View Transitions, the switch is instant.
- **Phones**: below 45rem each invoice line stacks, with every value next to its label.

Not used: the suggested web font (Plus Jakarta Sans), the blue button colour, scroll animations and a centred layout.

## Checked here

- **Contrast**: computed from the colour values. Body text is 16.74:1, secondary text 5.89:1, the red on white 6.54:1, the outline of the demo-style toggle 3.68:1. All pass.
- **Static audit script**: no problems left. It flagged hover without a transition on three elements, but the transitions are there on the base rules (`src/index.css:98`, `:127`, `:206`), so that's a false patterns hit. Its checks for common generated-page clichés found nothing.
- **Reduced motion**: handled in `src/index.css:451` and `src/MatchFigure.tsx:64`.
- **Colours**: none outside `src/tokens.css`, except the browser `theme-color` meta tag, which uses the background value.
- **Phone width**: I fixed the toggle, which would have run off the screen at 320px.

## Not verified

- **The build**: `npm run build` didn't run. One risk: the TypeScript version here keeps its browser type definitions inside a binary I couldn't read, so I couldn't check whether they include the View Transitions call. I typed that call by hand so the code should compile either way.
- **In a browser**: nothing was rendered. Still to check:
  - no horizontal scroll at 375, 768, 1024 and 1440px;
  - the toggle animation is smooth (a Chrome performance recording);
  - the reduced-motion setting actually makes it instant.
- **Above the fold**: on a 1440×900 screen, I estimate the last line or two of the example invoice and its summary sit just below the fold. The flagged lines should be visible.
- **The toggle animation itself**: it hasn't been seen running anywhere.

## Files

- **Written**: `src/App.tsx`, `src/MatchFigure.tsx`, `src/tokens.css`, `src/index.css`, `index.html`, `MASTER.md` (the design system).
- **Previews**, which won't ship: `preview/thesis.html` and `preview/design-system.html`.
- **Untouched**: `src/main.tsx`. `public/` is empty.

Modules loaded: tells, ui-ux-pro-max, motion-principles, css-native, mobile-principles, design-audit
Modules not loaded: none
